body:
acme-prod: Hey team, since this morning our /generate-legal-summary endpoint that runs the quantized fp8 model has a big p95 latency regression and ~4x increase in client-side timeouts. Started around 08:12 UTC. Can you look? :rotating_light:

Maya (CS): Sorry to hear that — we're on it. Can you paste the last request id or sample trace? Also which model variant and sequence lengths?

acme-prod: trace id 20260308-8c1, model=redwood-qa-fp8-v2, seq=256, typical batch=4. FP16 variant doesn't show the spike.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Thanks. Can you confirm if KV cache is enabled for that route and whether client sends cache-hits? Also any recent config changes (autoscaling / batch size)?

acme-prod: KV cache=true, cache hits ~70% (we think). No config changes on our side.

Ravi (eng-ml): Noted. Two quick theories: 1) FP8 calibration path is doing extra per-request work (dequant/quant loops) under certain sequence distributions; 2) kernel selection is falling back to a non-optimized GEMM for the current seq/batch combo.

Sofia (oncall): I pulled the runtime logs for that host pool (pool-qa-07). Kernel selection log shows: ``kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=generic_gemm fallback_reason=memory_alignment_mismatch`` for many requests around the incident window.

Ethan (eng-runtime): That matches a local repro I ran — when seq=256 and batch=4 we hit alignment path that avoids the FP8 fused kernels and triggers a slow software dequant loop. Numbers from repro: FP16 p95 ~220ms, FP8 p95 ~870ms. p50s: FP16 95ms, FP8 140ms.

Maya (CS): Oof. Customer is getting timeouts. Recommended immediate mitigation?

Ethan (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations: 1) Route that customer to the fp16 model variant (config route override) — we can do that without downtime. 2) Adjust routing policy to set max_batch=2 for the pool serving fp8 to avoid the fallback. 3) Disable KV cache for that route as a test if de/quant interplay with cache keys is involved.

Maya (CS): I'll propose routing to FP16 and open a support ticket for the config change. Can ops do #1 now if we give permission?

Sofia (oncall): I can flip the route to fp16 in 10min. Need explicit approval from account owner.

acme-prod: Please do it. We accept temporary route to FP16.

deploy-bot: deploy:route-update pool-qa-07 route=/generate-legal-summary -> redwood-qa-fp16-v3 by Sofia (oncall) at 2026-03-08T08:32:10Z

acme-prod: After switching to FP16 tail latency normalized within ~6 minutes. Thanks.

Ravi (eng-ml): For follow-up: we should run an automatic repro across sequence distributions to catch this. I ran a profile and saw hot loops in the dequant path: ``dequant_loop.cpp: line 178`` where it does scalar conversions because the vectorized path wasn't selected. That is triggered by a stride/alignment condition in the FP8 kernel registration.

Ethan (eng-runtime): I captured perf traces. Key findings: 1) FP8 path spends 57% cycles in dequant routines; 2) memory bandwidth usage up 2x compared to FP16 due to extra read/writes; 3) KV cache hit requests amplify garbage collection hotspots because they reorder tensor shapes.

Ravi (eng-ml): Related note: calibration step that runs per-instance to pick scaling factors is invoked on first request and can be re-triggered on shape changes — we saw calibration calls at ~1s each in logs. That's expensive.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Action items (short): - Add a temporary kernel registration change to prefer the vectorized FP8 kernel for common seq lengths (256, 512) — this is low-risk and should cut the p95 ~60%. - Guard calibration so it runs asynchronously and caches results across shape variants. - Add a heuristic to limit batch size when using FP8 kernels if sequence length high.

Ravi (eng-ml): I'll prototype the calibration cache PR and test on bench. Ethan can prepare the kernel registration patch.

Sofia (oncall): For customer comms: Maya — can you say "we routed you to FP16 while we fix FP8 path, expect no action needed on your side"?

Maya (CS): Yup sending note now.

acme-prod: Appreciate the fast response. Please keep us posted on timeline for permanent fix.

Ethan (eng-runtime): ETA for kernel registration patch + canary: 48 hours. Calibration cache PR: 72 hours. We'll monitor metrics and share a follow-up.

Ravi (eng-ml): Repro snippet I used (paste into bench):
```
# repro fp8 slowdown
for batch in [1,2,4,8]:
  run_payload(model='redwood-qa-fp8-v2', seq=256, batch=batch, kv_cache=true)
```
Look at p95 and kernel_selector logs.

Sofia (oncall): Logged incident: INC-2026-03-08-qa07, assigned to Ethan/Ravi. Adding runbooks for quick route overrides.

Maya (CS): Closing customer loop: emailed acme-prod with temporary FP16 routing and promise of updates.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Follow-ups: - I'll push the kernel pref change to canary and report numbers. - Add an alert for when FP8 p95 > FP16 p95 * 2 for more than 5 minutes.

Ravi (eng-ml): Also adding a unit test for calibration to avoid blocking in the hot path.

acme-prod: Thanks all, we'll keep watch. :thumbsup:
